name: What types of interior wall damage can be repaired?
description: Common interior wall damage includes cracks, holes, water stains, and peeling paint. Repair methods are tailored to the type and severity of the damage.

mainEntity.name: What types of interior wall damage can be repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior wall damage commonly repaired includes cracks, holes from anchors or impacts, water stains, peeling paint, and drywall inconsistencies. Smaller issues like nail pops or scuffs are also routine. Repair methods vary based on the damage's severity and the wall material, ensuring a smooth and consistent finish ready for paint or wallpaper. Addressing these issues promptly helps maintain the aesthetic and structural integrity of your home's interior.
